prompt: Compute the shortest legal import list for a set of class names, resolving simple-name clashes. Complete ImportListBuilder and run the tests.
explanation: Sorting the candidate names first makes the clash rule almost free: walking the sorted list and remembering which simple names are already claimed hands the import to the alphabetically first owner automatically. A TreeSet does the de-duplicating and the sorting in one step. Splitting the work into needed / winners / losers keeps each method short and means importLines and mustQualify can never disagree about which names were eligible in the first place.
hints: First reduce the input to the names that genuinely need an import, de-duplicated and sorted -- a TreeSet gives you both at once.
Walk that sorted list and keep a Set of simple names you have already claimed; Set.add returns false when the name is taken, which is exactly the clash test.
The names that must be written out in full are the needed names minus the winners, so removeAll does the job.
